votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the consent calendar as presented.

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Resolution No. 2025-008R to review and approve amendments to the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget as presented.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
